chapterInfo.content:
10
Noa awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ
(1 Berɛsosɛm 1.5-23)
1 # 1 Be 1.5-23 Na yeinom ne Noa mma Sem, Ham ne Yafet awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ. Na nsuyire no akyi, wɔwoo mma.
2Yafet mma nie: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Mesek ne Tiras. 3Na Gomer mma ne Askenas, Rifat ne Togarma. 4Na Yawan mma ne Elisa, Tarsis, Kitim ne Dodanim. 5#Sak 2.11 Yeinom mu na nsuano amanaman no firi kɔpetee wɔn nsase soɔ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mu biara kasa ne wɔn mmusua teɛ, wɔn amanaman mu.
6Na Ham mma ne Kus, Misraim, Put ne Kanaan. 7Na Kus mma ne Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Raama ne Sabteka. Na Raama mma ne Saba ne Dedan.
8Na Kus woo Nimrod. Ɔno na ɔdii kan yɛɛ ɔkatakyie wɔ asase soɔ. 9Na ɔyɛ ɔbɔmmɔfoɔ wɔ AWURADE anim; enti na wɔka sɛ: Ɔbɔmmɔfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔwɔ tumi AWURADE anim te sɛ Nimrod nie. 10Na n’ahennie mfitiaseɛ ne Babel, Erek, Akad ne Kalne a ɛwɔ Sinear asase soɔ. 11#Yona 1.2 Asase no so na ɔfiri kɔɔ Asiria kɔkyekyeree Ninewe ne Rehobot-ir ne Kala, 12ne Resen kuro kɛseɛ a ɛda Ninewe ne Kala ntam no. 13Na Misraim woo Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naftuhim, 14Patrusim, Kasluhim (a Filistifoɔ firii wɔn mu), ne Kaftorim.
15Kanaan woo n’abakan Sidon, ne Het, 16Yebusifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Girgasifoɔ, 17Hiwifoɔ, Arkifoɔ, Sinifoɔ, 18Arwadfoɔ, Semarifoɔ ne Hamatfoɔ. Ɛno akyi na Kanaanfoɔ mmusua peteeɛ. 19Na Kanaanfoɔ hyeɛ firi Sidon kɔduru Gerar de kɔsi Gasa kɔduru Sodom, Gomora, Adma ne Seboim de kɔsi Lasa. 20Yeinom ne Ham mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn kasa, wɔn nsase ne wɔn amanaman teɛ.
21 # Gye 11.10 Sem a ɔyɛ Yafet nua panin no mu na Eber mma nyinaa firie. 22Sem mma ne Elam, Asur, Arfaksad, Lud ne Aram. 23Na Aram mma ne Us, Hul, Geter ne Mas. 24Na Arfaksad woo Sela, na Sela woo Eber. 25#Gye 11.8 Na Eber woo mma baanu. Deɛ ɔdi kan no din de Peleg,#10.25 PELEG: Asekyerɛ ne: Nkyekyɛmu. ɛfiri sɛ ne nna mu na wɔkyekyɛɛ asase mu; na ne nua din de Yoktan. 26Na Yoktan woo Almodad, Selef, Hasarmawet, Yera, 27Hadoram, Usal, Dikla, 28Obal, Abimael, Saba, 29Ofir, Hawila ne Yobab. Yeinom nyinaa ne Yoktan mma. 30Na wɔn tenabea firi Mesa kɔduru Sefar, apueeɛ bepɔ so. 31Yeinom ne Sem mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn kasa, wɔn nsase ne wɔn amanaman teɛ. 32#Gye 9.1, 19 Yeinom ne Noa mma mmusua, sɛdeɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ teɛ wɔ wɔn amanaman mu. Na ɛfiri yeinom mu na nsuyire no akyi amanaman petee asase soɔ.

Na yeinom ne Noa mma Sem, Ham ne Yafet awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ. Na nsuyire no akyi, wɔwoo mma.
Yafet mma nie: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Mesek ne Tiras. Na Gomer mma ne Askenas, Rifat ne Togarma. Na Yawan mma ne Elisa, Tarsis, Kitim ne Dodanim. Yeinom mu na nsuano amanaman no firi kɔpetee wɔn nsase soɔ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mu biara kasa ne wɔn mmusua teɛ, wɔn amanaman mu.
Na Ham mma ne Kus, Misraim, Put ne Kanaan. Na Kus mma ne Seba, Hawila, Sabta, Raama ne Sabteka. Na Raama mma ne Saba ne Dedan.
Na Kus woo Nimrod. Ɔno na ɔdii kan yɛɛ ɔkatakyie wɔ asase soɔ. Na ɔyɛ ɔbɔmmɔfoɔ wɔ AWURADE anim; enti na wɔka sɛ: Ɔbɔmmɔfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔwɔ tumi AWURADE anim te sɛ Nimrod nie. Na n’ahennie mfitiaseɛ ne Babel, Erek, Akad ne Kalne a ɛwɔ Sinear asase soɔ. Asase no so na ɔfiri kɔɔ Asiria kɔkyekyeree Ninewe ne Rehobot-ir ne Kala, ne Resen kuro kɛseɛ a ɛda Ninewe ne Kala ntam no. Na Misraim woo Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naftuhim, Patrusim, Kasluhim (a Filistifoɔ firii wɔn mu), ne Kaftorim.
Kanaan woo n’abakan Sidon, ne Het, Yebusifoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Girgasifoɔ, Hiwifoɔ, Arkifoɔ, Sinifoɔ, Arwadfoɔ, Semarifoɔ ne Hamatfoɔ. Ɛno akyi na Kanaanfoɔ mmusua peteeɛ. Na Kanaanfoɔ hyeɛ firi Sidon kɔduru Gerar de kɔsi Gasa kɔduru Sodom, Gomora, Adma ne Seboim de kɔsi Lasa. Yeinom ne Ham mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn kasa, wɔn nsase ne wɔn amanaman teɛ.
Sem a ɔyɛ Yafet nua panin no mu na Eber mma nyinaa firie. Sem mma ne Elam, Asur, Arfaksad, Lud ne Aram. Na Aram mma ne Us, Hul, Geter ne Mas. Na Arfaksad woo Sela, na Sela woo Eber. Na Eber woo mma baanu. Deɛ ɔdi kan no din de Peleg, ɛfiri sɛ ne nna mu na wɔkyekyɛɛ asase mu; na ne nua din de Yoktan. Na Yoktan woo Almodad, Selef, Hasarmawet, Yera, Hadoram, Usal, Dikla, Obal, Abimael, Saba, Ofir, Hawila ne Yobab. Yeinom nyinaa ne Yoktan mma. Na wɔn tenabea firi Mesa kɔduru Sefar, apueeɛ bepɔ so. Yeinom ne Sem mma, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn kasa, wɔn nsase ne wɔn amanaman teɛ. Yeinom ne Noa mma mmusua, sɛdeɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ teɛ wɔ wɔn amanaman mu. Na ɛfiri yeinom mu na nsuyire no akyi amanaman petee asase soɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
